Follow up: Got the Fitbit Charge for Christmas and for the most part, pretty happy with it. One thing to note, it has a function to track the number of flights of stairs you climb. However, if you use a stair master at the gym and do say 50 floors, it registers 0. I sent a message to Fitbit support asking about this and they told me that the Fitbit determines how many stairs you climb by detecting minuet changes in atmospheric pressure as your altitude increases, since on a stair master you're not actually increasing your altitude, it doesn't register. I'd be okay with this, but, it also doesn't register them as steps either.
